newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Dec 9.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Dec 9.

text.p: * Central Parking Corp said it agreed to buy Square Industries Inc for $31 per share, mostly in cash. Square Industries closed Friday at 28-1/4. Central Parking closed at 32-7/8.
* Hayes Wheels said it would buy a roughly 77 percent interest in Lemmerz Holding GmbH in a cash and stock deal worth about $295 million. Hayes Wheels closed at 34-3/4.

* Homestake Mining Co said it agreed to acquire Santa Fe Pacific Gold Corp for $17.42 per share in stock, or about $2.3 billion. Last week Newmont Mining Corp proposed to acquire Santa Fe Pacific for $2 billion in stock. Homestake closed at 15-5/8, Newmont closed at 46-7/8 and Santa Fe Pacific closed at 15-3/8.
* Limited Inc Chairman and Chief Executive Leslie Wexner said he expects fourth quarter profits to rise close to 50 percent, the New York Times reported on Sunday. Limited closed at 18-1/4.
